name: known
says: The causes the records of the placed questions may hold, by game, each with its explanation (plan 79.48 part E). A record that holds a cause not named here is `failing`; tests/test_plan79_48.py holds that a record's causes are exactly the ones named for its game. The state that shows each cause is an ignored test of rust/engine/game/tests/translated_placed_known.rs. Plan 79.50 mended the one cause held until then (reach_from, the first move of two places); no cause is named for any game.
